**How to submit:** Write on paper or in a document. Upload a clear photo or a PDF to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 5**.

*Snow Post* is a mobile game. Pebble, a young penguin, delivers letters
across an icy island. A storm has put out the light of the lighthouse, so
ships cannot find the island. Pebble wants to light the lighthouse again,
but the road goes through dark caves, and Pebble is afraid of the dark. If
the light stays off, no ship brings food to the island.
